Apple's big iPhone event is set to kick off in September, and alongside the new iPhone models, we can expect the debut of new Apple Watch variants. Here's a look at the rumored upgrades for the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 are expected to come with new chipsets, health features, and various other improvements.

If you're excited about next month's new iPhone announcements, there has been a flood of leaks revealing what we can expect from the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra.

However, while new Apple Watch models are set to debut at the same event, coverage of those has been notably sparse.

Apple is widely expected to unveil two new Watch models at its September event:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • Apple Watch Series 12

According to a recent Bloomberg report from Mark Gurman, both models will receive "the long-awaited chip and speed improvements."

The current Watch models use the S10 chip, and performance has largely stagnated since the S9 in 2023. With watchOS 27 bringing Siri AI, the arrival of a more powerful S11 chip couldn't be more timely.

Digitimes has claimed the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will receive a "major redesign," though Gurman believes significant design changes are at least a year away. He does note, however, that Apple may reintroduce a ceramic case option with this year's models.

The same Digitimes report also states that the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will feature "significantly upgraded sensing capabilities," with the number of sensors potentially doubling.

Some of the new sensors could be related to the rumored expansion of high blood pressure notifications.

Apple introduced high blood pressure notifications last year with watchOS 26. Reports indicate that the FDA is currently reviewing approval for a new high blood pressure-related notification feature, which is expected to debut alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12.

New Apple Watch Models: Key Takeaways

Overall, there's still plenty of room for Apple to surprise us with the new Watch models. A new chip, minor design updates, and health features are all expected, but we'll have to wait until next month for the full picture.

What features are you hoping to see in the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12? Let us know in the comments below.
